hypothesis: Infer a valence-preserving, context-conditioned molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and categorical production prior from the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each independent objective by repeatedly hard-selecting elite complete evaluated derivations and applying a smoothed maximum-likelihood cross-entropy projection of the production distribution toward those elites before ancestrally sampling new complete derivations.
method_thesis: Infer a valence-preserving molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and context-conditioned production-rule prior from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining only reusable rules and counts rather than whole corpus molecules. In each independently restarted objective session, parse the ten fixed scored molecules into grammar derivations and initialize a task-local categorical rule distribution from the corpus prior. Generate every subsequent proposal de novo by ancestrally sampling a complete derivation from the start symbol, applying its productions to obtain a molecular graph, and locally resampling after invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate outcomes until the evaluator-announced batch is full. After each oracle response, select the highest-ranked evaluated derivations and perform the defining cross-entropy update: maximum-likelihood refit the context-conditioned rule probabilities to that elite set, with fixed smoothing toward the preceding distribution. Thus feedback moves probability mass toward production combinations occurring in the best complete molecules without crossover, mutation, a surrogate, a value function, or a finite candidate library; the sole optimization target is a stronger terminal Top-1 in each of the five independent sessions and hence their equal-weight mean.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline grammar and conditional-prior estimation followed by task-local elite maximum-likelihood projection of categorical rule probabilities
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: ancestral sampling of complete de novo graph derivations from an elite-refit probabilistic molecular grammar
method_tags.representation: molecular hypergraph-replacement derivations with corpus-derived context-conditioned production rules

activation_observables.name: grammar_parse_and_reconstruction_support

activation_observables.measurement: At every feedback update, record the configured elite quota, every eligible evaluated derivation and its oracle-score rank, and the selected elite identities; report the fraction of updates whose selected set exactly equals the highest-ranked eligible complete derivations under deterministic tie handling, relative to a zero-exact-selection reference.
activation_observables.name: reward_rank_elite_selection_exactness

activation_observables.measurement: For every refit, evaluate the selected elite derivations under the categorical production distributions immediately before and after the smoothed maximum-likelihood update and report the increase in their mean normalized log likelihood, with per-context elite production counts, pre-update probabilities, maximum-likelihood probabilities, post-update probabilities, and smoothing identity sufficient to reproduce the projection.
activation_observables.name: elite_cross_entropy_projection_lift

activation_observables.measurement: After every nondegenerate elite refit, report the production-count-weighted total-variation distance between the pre-update and post-update context-conditioned rule distributions, the number of contexts and productions whose probabilities changed, and the probability mass transferred toward productions overrepresented in the selected elites.
activation_observables.name: feedback_conditioned_rule_distribution_shift

activation_observables.name: complete_hypergraph_derivation_trace_rate

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus supplies enough recurring molecular contexts to infer a reusable valence-preserving grammar with useful complete-derivation and reconstruction coverage.
The retained grammar covers all fixed initial molecules and can construct novel valid molecules at a yield sufficient to fill every evaluator-announced batch within the proposal limit.
High-scoring molecules share production combinations with earlier elite evaluated derivations, so concentrating categorical rule mass by reward rank improves later proposal quality.
Fixed smoothing preserves enough support to avoid premature categorical collapse during the 29 adaptive batch-10 feedback rounds.

The result may not transfer when the rewarding chemistry requires rare context interactions that the factorized conditional production distribution cannot represent, or productions absent from the corpus-derived grammar.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the retained grammar cannot parse and exactly reconstruct the fixed initial molecules or cannot generate complete valid novel molecules, if elite identities are not determined solely by oracle-score rank, or if a nondegenerate smoothed elite refit produces no reproducible increase in elite normalized log likelihood and no change in the categorical production distribution used by subsequent ancestral proposals.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to extract reusable context-conditioned hypergraph production rules and counts from the unlabeled corpus and publish only that grammar state. Implement run mode to seed all randomness from init, parse the fixed evaluated molecules into grammar derivations, maintain a task-local categorical rule distribution initialized from the corpus prior, generate novel molecules de novo from the start symbol by ancestral rule sampling, and after each accepted feedback batch refit context-specific rule probabilities to the highest-ranked eligible complete derivations with fixed smoothing toward the preceding distribution; locally reject and resample invalid, already evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate products until the evaluator-announced batch is full.
research_intent.mechanism: Infer a valence-preserving, context-conditioned molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and categorical production prior from the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each independent objective by repeatedly hard-selecting elite complete evaluated derivations and applying a smoothed maximum-likelihood cross-entropy projection of the production distribution toward those elites before ancestrally sampling new complete derivations.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a task-agnostic de novo constructor must convert sparse rank feedback into reusable structural bias while continuing to generate complete valid molecules, without retrieving corpus molecules or depending on a learned value function or surrogate.

applicability_conditions: Corpus-derived grammar estimation is supported under this preparation configuration: 59,237 usable training molecules yielded 512 retained attachment-labelled rules, 47 compatibility pairs, 30 online categorical contexts, and a nonzero but conditional 45/320 held-out exact-reconstruction rate.
The grammar is applicable to the supplied fixed seed-0 panels: all 50/50 initial molecules across five independent objective sessions parsed, exactly reconstructed, and replayed with no failures.

Hard reward-rank selection and cross-entropy projection are supported when evaluated molecules have complete retained derivations: all 149 updates selected exactly the deterministic top-ranked eligible set, increased elite normalized log likelihood, and changed the distribution used by subsequent successful proposals.

De novo generation is supported while enough probability remains on novel derivations: 144 complete batches and 1,440 traced emissions were produced, covering every adaptive call for four tasks and the first 28 rounds of drd2_docking.

Full-session applicability is not supported when repeated elite refits collapse probability onto evaluated products. drd2_docking could not fill its final batch even after 25,000 attempts, so fixed smoothing 0.42 did not preserve sufficient practical novelty support for every 29-round session.

The evidence does not extend to rewarding molecules requiring productions absent from the retained grammar or higher-order production combinations not represented by the factorized context-conditioned categorical policy, and it does not establish behavior beyond seed 0.

observable_measurements.name: novel_valid_grammar_generation_yield
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this lineage root. The zero-generation reference has no valid novel emissions and yield 0.0.
observable_measurements.value: The 144 completed suggestion rounds emitted 1,440 unique valid previously unevaluated canonical molecules from 22,344 ancestral attempts, for pooled all-attempt yield 0.0644468313641246. Of those attempts, 22,301 reached complete valid derivations, giving pooled complete-derivation novel yield 0.064571095466571. Logged accounting is exact in every completed round: 2 incomplete derivations, 0 rule-or-valence failures, 41 sanitization failures, 20,801 already-evaluated molecules, 0 prior-emission collisions, 60 within-batch collisions, and 1,440 emissions sum to all 22,344 attempts. All 144 logged rounds emitted exactly the announced batch of 10. Sustained batch filling was not complete, however: the 145th requested batch, drd2_docking round 29, accumulated only 8 of 10 proposals in 25,000 attempts and raised before logging category counts or sending a batch. Thus 144/145 requested batches were filled; the four other tasks reached 300 calls, while drd2_docking stopped at 290. On that task the last successful round already required 12,391 attempts for 10 emissions and classified 12,378 attempts as already evaluated, compared with 12 attempts for 10 emissions in its first round.

possible_failure_causes: Repeated cumulative hard-elite projection can concentrate nearly all probability on derivations already evaluated. On drd2_docking, novel yield fell from 10/12 attempts in round 1 to 10/12,391 in round 28, where 12,378 attempts reproduced evaluated molecules, and the following batch found only 8/10 in the 25,000-attempt cap.

The configured 0.42 smoothing is interpolation toward the preceding distribution, not a fixed lower-bound mixture with the corpus prior. Consequently productions absent from repeated elite sets can decay geometrically; after the drd2_docking round-28 refit the ROOT context's total post-update mass outside the two active elite start rules was only 0.000011009016773423532.

The retained 512-rule grammar exactly reconstructed only 45/320 eligibility-filtered held-out molecules, with 275 unavailable-rule failures. Rare fragments or context interactions absent from those retained productions can therefore remain unreachable even when all supplied fixed molecules happen to parse.

The held-out reservoir is populated only after canonicalization, decomposition, attachment-length, and piece-eligibility checks, so the preparation metric does not expose raw-corpus sanitization or parse failure rates and may overstate broad grammar coverage.

The failed-batch completeness check raises before the yield diagnostic and before traces are committed, leaving the terminal drd2_docking attempt's incomplete, rule/valence, sanitization, evaluated, prior-emission, and collision breakdown unavailable.

Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and no Parent comparison. It establishes activation and predicted intermediate movement, but not multi-seed reliability or that the observed categorical concentration improves terminal score on objectives whose rewarding chemistry requires higher-order rule interactions.

Hard reward-rank selection and cross-entropy projection are supported when evaluated molecules have complete retained derivations: all 149 updates selected exactly the deterministic top-ranked eligible set, increased elite normalized log likelihood, and changed the distribution used by subsequent successful proposals.

De novo generation is supported while enough probability remains on novel derivations: 144 complete batches and 1,440 traced emissions were produced, covering every adaptive call for four tasks and the first 28 rounds of drd2_docking.

Full-session applicability is not supported when repeated elite refits collapse probability onto evaluated products. drd2_docking could not fill its final batch even after 25,000 attempts, so fixed smoothing 0.42 did not preserve sufficient practical novelty support for every 29-round session.

The evidence does not extend to rewarding molecules requiring productions absent from the retained grammar or higher-order production combinations not represented by the factorized context-conditioned categorical policy, and it does not establish behavior beyond seed 0.

possible_failure_causes: Repeated cumulative hard-elite projection can concentrate nearly all probability on derivations already evaluated. On drd2_docking, novel yield fell from 10/12 attempts in round 1 to 10/12,391 in round 28, where 12,378 attempts reproduced evaluated molecules, and the following batch found only 8/10 in the 25,000-attempt cap.

The configured 0.42 smoothing is interpolation toward the preceding distribution, not a fixed lower-bound mixture with the corpus prior. Consequently productions absent from repeated elite sets can decay geometrically; after the drd2_docking round-28 refit the ROOT context's total post-update mass outside the two active elite start rules was only 0.000011009016773423532.

The retained 512-rule grammar exactly reconstructed only 45/320 eligibility-filtered held-out molecules, with 275 unavailable-rule failures. Rare fragments or context interactions absent from those retained productions can therefore remain unreachable even when all supplied fixed molecules happen to parse.

The held-out reservoir is populated only after canonicalization, decomposition, attachment-length, and piece-eligibility checks, so the preparation metric does not expose raw-corpus sanitization or parse failure rates and may overstate broad grammar coverage.

The failed-batch completeness check raises before the yield diagnostic and before traces are committed, leaving the terminal drd2_docking attempt's incomplete, rule/valence, sanitization, evaluated, prior-emission, and collision breakdown unavailable.

Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and no Parent comparison. It establishes activation and predicted intermediate movement, but not multi-seed reliability or that the observed categorical concentration improves terminal score on objectives whose rewarding chemistry requires higher-order rule interactions.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus supplies enough recurring molecular contexts to infer a reusable valence-preserving grammar with useful complete-derivation and reconstruction coverage.
The retained grammar covers all fixed initial molecules and can construct novel valid molecules at a yield sufficient to fill every evaluator-announced batch within the proposal limit.
High-scoring molecules share production combinations with earlier elite evaluated derivations, so concentrating categorical rule mass by reward rank improves later proposal quality.
Fixed smoothing preserves enough support to avoid premature categorical collapse during the 29 adaptive batch-10 feedback rounds.

The result may not transfer when the rewarding chemistry requires rare context interactions that the factorized conditional production distribution cannot represent, or productions absent from the corpus-derived grammar.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the retained grammar cannot parse and exactly reconstruct the fixed initial molecules or cannot generate complete valid novel molecules, if elite identities are not determined solely by oracle-score rank, or if a nondegenerate smoothed elite refit produces no reproducible increase in elite normalized log likelihood and no change in the categorical production distribution used by subsequent ancestral proposals.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to extract reusable context-conditioned hypergraph production rules and counts from the unlabeled corpus and publish only that grammar state. Implement run mode to seed all randomness from init, parse the fixed evaluated molecules into grammar derivations, maintain a task-local categorical rule distribution initialized from the corpus prior, generate novel molecules de novo from the start symbol by ancestral rule sampling, and after each accepted feedback batch refit context-specific rule probabilities to the highest-ranked eligible complete derivations with fixed smoothing toward the preceding distribution; locally reject and resample invalid, already evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate products until the evaluator-announced batch is full.
research_intent.mechanism: Infer a valence-preserving, context-conditioned molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and categorical production prior from the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each independent objective by repeatedly hard-selecting elite complete evaluated derivations and applying a smoothed maximum-likelihood cross-entropy projection of the production distribution toward those elites before ancestrally sampling new complete derivations.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a task-agnostic de novo constructor must convert sparse rank feedback into reusable structural bias while continuing to generate complete valid molecules, without retrieving corpus molecules or depending on a learned value function or surrogate.
